_doc: Curated, source-verified research for local Berkeley ballot measures: one-line summary + required pass_threshold (majority | 55 | two_thirds) + threshold_note + source_url. Thresholds are taken from official ballot labels / City Clerk certifications where available. NOTE the Upland nuance: voter/citizen-initiative special taxes need only a majority (e.g. 2024 EE/FF/GG), unlike government-placed special taxes (2/3). build_measures.py overlays these onto measures.json.

Measure D - City of Berkeley.summary: One-cent-per-ounce general tax on distributors of sugar-sweetened beverages.
Measure D - City of Berkeley.threshold_note: General tax to the general fund — simple majority.

Measure F - City of Berkeley.summary: Increased the special parcel tax funding city parks, trees, and landscaping.

Measure O - City of Berkeley.summary: Amended the city charter to conform elections, recall, and petition rules to state law.

Measure P - City of Berkeley.summary: Advisory measure urging a constitutional amendment that corporations are not people.

Measure Q - City of Berkeley.summary: Advisory measure supporting a right for employees to request shorter or part-time hours.

Measure R - City of Berkeley.summary: Initiative to amend downtown zoning with height limits and affordable-housing rules.

Measure S - City of Berkeley.summary: Referendum on the City Council's 2013 redistricting map based on the 2010 Census.
Measure S - City of Berkeley.threshold_note: Referendum on an ordinance — simple majority.

Measure AA - City of Berkeley.summary: Raised relocation payments landlords owe tenants evicted for owner move-in.

Measure BB - City of Berkeley.summary: Proposed raising Berkeley's minimum wage to $15 per hour on a set schedule.

Measure CC - City of Berkeley.summary: Proposed raising the minimum wage toward $16.37 and expanding paid sick leave.

Measure DD - City of Berkeley.summary: Proposed raising the business-license tax on landlords of three or more units to 1.5%.

Measure E1 - Berkeley USD.summary: Renewed an 8-year school parcel tax of 37¢ per square foot for Berkeley public schools.
Measure E1 - Berkeley USD.threshold_note: School district special parcel tax — two-thirds.

Measure U1 - City of Berkeley.summary: Raised the business-license tax on landlords with five or more units to 2.88%.

Measure V1 - City of Berkeley.summary: Raised the city's Gann appropriations limit to allow spending approved tax revenue.
Measure V1 - City of Berkeley.threshold_note: Appropriations-limit override, not a tax — majority.

Measure W1 - City of Berkeley.summary: Amended the charter to move redistricting to an independent citizens commission.

Measure X1 - City of Berkeley.summary: Amended the charter to create a Fair Elections Fund matching small campaign donations.
Measure X1 - City of Berkeley.threshold_note: Charter amendment (general-fund program), not a tax — majority.

Measure Y1 - City of Berkeley.summary: Amended the charter to let 16- and 17-year-olds vote in school board elections.

Measure Z1 - City of Berkeley.summary: Authorized public agencies to develop up to 500 low-rent housing units.
Measure Z1 - City of Berkeley.threshold_note: Article XXXIV public-housing authorization, not a tax — majority.

Measure P - City of Berkeley.summary: Increased the real-property transfer tax on sales over $1.5M to fund homeless services.

Measure Q - City of Berkeley.summary: Amended the rent stabilization ordinance's exemptions for new construction and ADUs.

Measure R - City of Berkeley.summary: Non-binding advisory measure endorsing the Vision 2050 infrastructure plan.

Measure E - Berkeley USD.summary: 12-year school parcel tax (~12.4¢/sq ft) funding Berkeley schools staff salaries.

Measure H - Berkeley USD.summary: 10-year school parcel tax (~9¢/sq ft) funding maintenance, grounds, and facilities.
Measure H - Berkeley USD.threshold_note: Dedicated special parcel tax (not a Prop-39 bond) — two-thirds.

Measure FF - City of Berkeley.summary: Special parcel tax funding firefighting, emergency medical response, and wildfire prevention.
Measure FF - City of Berkeley.threshold_note: Government-placed special parcel tax; ballot label 'Needs 2/3 vote to pass.'

Measure GG - City of Berkeley.summary: Tax on Uber/Lyft trips originating in Berkeley for general municipal services.
Measure GG - City of Berkeley.threshold_note: General tax (any municipal purpose); ballot label 'Majority vote.'

Measure HH - City of Berkeley.summary: Proposed raising the utility-users tax on electricity and gas from 7.5% to 10%.
Measure HH - City of Berkeley.threshold_note: General tax for general services; ballot label 'Majority vote required.'

Measure II - City of Berkeley.summary: Charter amendment creating an independent Police Accountability Board and director.
Measure II - City of Berkeley.threshold_note: Charter amendment; ballot label 'Majority vote required.'

Measure JJ - City of Berkeley.summary: Charter amendment tying Mayor and Council salaries to Alameda County median income.

Measure KK - City of Berkeley.summary: Charter amendment removing firefighter residency rules and updating other provisions.
Measure KK - City of Berkeley.threshold_note: Charter amendment; ballot label 'Majority vote required.'

Measure LL - City of Berkeley.summary: Raised the Gann appropriations limit to spend existing tax revenue, FY2021–2024.
Measure LL - City of Berkeley.threshold_note: Appropriations-limit measure, not a tax; ballot label 'Needs majority.'

Measure MM - City of Berkeley.summary: Amended the rent ordinance to bar emergency-period nonpayment evictions and add fees.

Measure M - City of Berkeley.summary: Annual tax on long-vacant residential units, with revenue to the general fund.

Measure N - City of Berkeley.summary: Authorized public agencies to develop up to 3,000 units of low-rent housing.

Measure H - Berkeley USD.summary: Renews Berkeley schools' BSEP special parcel tax for staffing, programs, and libraries.

Measure W - City of Berkeley.summary: Amends the real-property transfer tax, raising rates on high-value sales and removing its sunset.
Measure W - City of Berkeley.threshold_note: General tax; City certification 'Majority Vote Required.'

Measure X - City of Berkeley.summary: Creates a special parcel tax to fund Berkeley Public Library facilities and services.
Measure X - City of Berkeley.threshold_note: Government-placed special parcel tax; City certification 'Two-thirds Vote Required.'

Measure Y - City of Berkeley.summary: Increases the special parcel tax rate for parks, trees, and landscaping maintenance.
Measure Y - City of Berkeley.threshold_note: Government-placed special parcel tax; City certification 'Two-thirds Vote Required.'

Measure Z - City of Berkeley.summary: Removes the expiration date on Berkeley's general sugar-sweetened-beverage tax.
Measure Z - City of Berkeley.threshold_note: General tax; City certification 'Majority Vote Required.'

Measure AA - City of Berkeley.summary: Raises the Gann appropriations limit to spend existing tax proceeds, FY2025–2028.
Measure AA - City of Berkeley.threshold_note: Appropriations-limit authorization, not a tax; City certification 'Majority Vote Required.'

Measure BB - City of Berkeley.summary: Amends the rent stabilization ordinance on eviction grounds, rent caps, and tenant associations.
Measure BB - City of Berkeley.threshold_note: Ordinance amendment; City certification 'Majority Vote Required.'

Measure CC - City of Berkeley.summary: Competing rent measure creating direct rental payments and amending the rent ordinance.
Measure CC - City of Berkeley.threshold_note: Ordinance amendment; City certification 'Majority Vote Required.'

Measure DD - City of Berkeley.summary: Prohibits establishing or expanding concentrated animal feeding operations in Berkeley.
Measure DD - City of Berkeley.threshold_note: Regulatory ordinance, not a tax; City certification 'Majority Vote Required.'

Measure EE - City of Berkeley.summary: Competing measure creating a 12-year special parcel tax for street and sidewalk repairs.
Measure EE - City of Berkeley.threshold_note: Voter-initiative special tax (Upland) — majority; City certification 'Majority Vote Required.'

Measure FF - City of Berkeley.summary: Creates a 14-year special parcel tax for street, sidewalk, and pedestrian-path repairs.
Measure FF - City of Berkeley.threshold_note: Voter-initiative special tax (Upland) — majority; City certification 'Majority Vote Required.'

Measure GG - City of Berkeley.summary: Would tax natural-gas use in large buildings to fund building decarbonization.
Measure GG - City of Berkeley.threshold_note: Citizen-initiative special tax (Upland) — majority; City certification 'Majority Vote Required.'

Measure HH - City of Berkeley.summary: Requires minimum indoor air-quality standards for city-owned and city-leased buildings.
Measure HH - City of Berkeley.threshold_note: Ordinance, not a tax; City certification 'Majority Vote Required.'
